manifest.description: Reverse of elixir-extract-module: inline a small module file into a target file, preserving the defmodule wrapper. Source file content replaced with a leave-behind comment for follow-up deletion.
when_to_use: a small module proved too small to justify its own file; consolidate back into the parent
cleanup pass after a refactor left orphaned single-fn modules
anti_patterns: do not inline a module that defines defstruct — refused with module_is_struct_carrier
do not inline a @behaviour module — refused with module_is_behaviour
do not inline modules with @before_compile / @after_compile callbacks

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-inline-module.

Protocol:
1. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="inline_elixir_module", source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}").
2. Refuse on module_is_struct_carrier / module_is_behaviour / module_has_compile_callbacks / no_defmodule / target_not_found / target_no_defmodule.
3. Apply with mix compile.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<inlined_module → target_module>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{apply}}
